UserProfileDoc.title: UserProfileDoc
UserProfileDoc.description: Metadata document for a user's Reelist account and initial seed state.

seeded.description: Whether initial sample entries have been seeded for this user.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile state update.

LibraryEntry.title: LibraryEntry
LibraryEntry.description: A movie or TV series tracked in a user's personal watchlist library with episode progress.

id.description: Composite entry identifier in the format {tmdbId}_{mediaType}.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this library entry.

tmdbId.description: Numeric TMDB identifier for the movie or series.

status.description: Current watch status in the user's library.

title.description: Cached title of the movie or series.

runtimeMinutes.description: Runtime in minutes per movie or average episode.

notes.description: Personal user notes on the title.

watched.description: Map of seasonNumber string to array of watched episode numbers.

resumeSeason.description: Calculated season number to resume from.

resumeEpisode.description: Calculated episode number to resume from.

totalEpisodes.description: Total aired episodes count across regular seasons.

hasNewEpisodes.description: Whether new aired episodes exist after completion.

lastWatchedAt.description: ISO timestamp when an episode was last checked.

startedAt.description: Date when the user started watching.

finishedAt.description: Date when the user finished watching.

addedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the entry was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the entry was last updated.

accentGradient.description: Pair of hex color strings for fallback card gradient.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user metadata document restricted strictly to the owner.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Per-user watchlist and episode tracking entries restricted strictly to the owner.
